steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ltx-gprobe-g25-0811"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/ltx-gprobe-0811/g25/10-ltx-gprobe-g25-0811-s20260897.mp4*"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    # Hash the COPY, not the original: what this records has to be the
    # bytes that get committed, or the manifest attests to the wrong file.
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
    print("   ", os.path.basename(f), h[:16])
# newline="\n" is load-bearing: Windows text mode rewrites \n to \r\n and
# every filename then carries a trailing \r that shasum -c cannot open.
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ltx-gprobe-g25-0811.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
# The clip and its §7.2 sidecar. Fewer means the render wrote less than
# it promised and the arm cannot be read against the other two.
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) == 2 else 1)
